title: One column set; unit shows number + year/make/model
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a service advisor (view customers; edit customers to raise a work order), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. Open Customers from the top navigation and switch to its "Maintenance reminders" tab. For the location cases use a two-workplace org (on a one-workplace org the location filter is absent).
  3. Rows including a unit with a unit number and one without; use a two-workplace org to see the location column.
custom_steps:
1. Read the column headers and confirm the set is constant across groups (cells adapt, columns do not change).
  2. Read how the unit is rendered for a unit with a number and one without.
  3. Check whether a location column renders on a one-workplace org versus a multi-workplace org.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The column set is one across every group (cells adapt, columns do not change): asset, customer, service, due status, due (with confidence or rule beneath), work order (with status), actions.
  • The unit reads as unit number then year, make and model, falling back to year, make and model where there is no unit number.
  • The location column renders only for an organization with more than one workplace.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; story SV-10570 (S13, The worklist); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), S13; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S13-R6: “The column set will be one across every group, with cells adapting rather than columns changing: asset, customer, service, due status, due with its confidence or rule beneath, work order with its status, actions”
  • S13-R7: “The unit will read as unit number followed by year, make and model, falling back to year, make and model where there is no unit number”
  • S13-R9: “The location column will render only for an organization with more than one workplace”
